title: Slushie Bar Salts Strawberry Apple Blackcurrant 10ml E-Liquid
description: Strawberry Apple Blackcurrant from Slushie Bar Salts is a masterfully crafted e-liquid that intertwines the sweet flavours of Strawberries and Apples with the rich depth of Blackcurrants. This Nic Salt blend offers a delightful fusion of fruit flavours, creating a multi-dimensional vaping experience. The e-liquid begins with the bright and juicy taste of Strawberries, offering a burst of summery sweetness. This sweetness is perfectly complemented by the crisp and refreshing flavour of Apples, adding a light and clean note to the mix. The Blackcurrants then come into play, bringing a deep and satisfying richness that perfectly rounds off the flavour profile. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the unique nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. If you enjoy this flavour, there are plenty more Slushie Bar Salts flavours to try. Few e-liquid makers have mastered the icy joys of slushy flavours quite like Slushie, a UK company who are behind an irresistible line of 50ml and 100ml shortfill and Nic Salts e-liquids that blend mouth-watering fruit flavours with healthy doses of icy menthol for an unparalleled slushy vaping experience. We’re also thrilled to stock Slushy Bar Salts: Nic Salt e-liquids that capture the intense flavour and satisfaction of your favourite disposable vape flavours in handy 10ml bottles for use with a wide variety of MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits.
